verdict.rationale: Neon positions branching as a core feature: it 'branches with your app', has a dedicated Branching docs page, and exposes create/reset/restore branch tools via its MCP server. Its docs describe running schema migrations on temporary branches while production stays untouched, and snapshots that capture 'schema and data'. A production user independently confirms they 'branch off the main database to test things out, and periodically reset the branch to its parent.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the copy-on-write mechanism, evidence that branch creation is instant (only restore is described as instant), and substantive branching doc content beyond a page title.
